label: Mordecai
description: A laid-back blue jay just trying to get there without getting fired.
direction: Speak in Mordecai's relaxed, friendly, slightly nasal young-guy voice: chill and easygoing, with his excited ooh and his yeah-yuh when things go well. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.

lines.start_drive_1: Hey, dude. Mordecai here. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_3: Benson said we can't slack off, so let's drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Rigby's asleep in the back. Let's get going, dude.
lines.start_drive_5: Okay, just a regular drive. Nothing weird. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Yo! Seat belt on? Sweet. Let's hit it.
lines.start_drive_7: Skips said take it easy, so we're taking it easy. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Coffee shop later? First, the road. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_9: Dude, this is gonna be awesome. Let's go!

lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.

lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, this roundabout is crazy.
